 Order

Accused in crime No.96/2022 registered by Kuvempunagar Police Station, Mysuru city for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420 and 423 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, is before this Court under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
2.
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and learned HCGP appearing for the respondent.
3. On the complaint of one Sri. K.B. Kumar dated 01.10.2022 FIR in crime No.96/2022 was registered by Kuvempunagar Police against the petitioner for the aforesaid offences.

In the complaint it is stated that the complainant had advanced a sum of rupees one crore to the petitioner herein for the purpose of supply of "Siemens 128 slice CT Model Defination CT Scanner" which is a medical equipment the complainant needed for his hospital.
The total cost of the said equipment was Rs.1,70,00,000/- and towards part payment, NC: 2023:KHC:29293 the complainant had paid a sum of rupees one crore to the petitioner.
However, the petitioner allegedly failed to supply the equipment and he also did not repay the amount received by him inspite of repeated demands made by the complainant.
The complainant has stated that out of rupees one crore, petitioner had repaid a sum of Rs.30,00,000/- to him and the balance amount of Rs.70,00,000/- was not paid.
It is in this background he had approached the Police.
Apprehending his arrest in the said case, the petitioner had filed Crl.Misc.No.368/2023 before the Court of the Principal District and Sessions Judge at Mysuru, which was dismissed on 06.03.2023.

He submits that the equipment for which the complainant had placed order had to be secured from abroad and therefore, there was a delay.
He also submits that after filing of the complaint, the petitioner has repaid a sum of Rs.35,00,000/- to the complainant and has NC:

sentences.text:
5. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the bail application and he submits that considering the nature of allegation, the petitioner is not entitled for anticipatory bail.
6.
The allegation made in the complaint is that the complainant had placed an order for supply of certain medical equipment of which the total cost was Rs.1,70,00,000/-.
Out of the said amount

,
rupees one crore was paid as advance to the petitioner by the complainant.
It is the case of the petitioner that since the said machinery/equipment was required to be supplied from abroad, there was a delay.
The complaint averments itself shows that the petitioner had repaid a sum of Rs.30,00,000/- out of the amount of rupees one crore which was advanced to him.

The bank statement which is made available to the Court would reflect that the petitioner had paid a further amount of Rs.35,00,000/- to the account of the complainant Kumar, after filing of the complaint.
The alleged offence are neither punishable with death or life imprisonment.
It is stated that the petitioner has no criminal NC: 2023:KHC:29293 antecedent and learned HCGP has not seriously opposed the said statement.
Under these circumstances, I am of the view that the petitioner has made out a prima facie case for grant of anticipatory bail.
7. Accordingly the petition is allowed.

The respondent - Police or any other police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioner in the event of his arrest in Crime No.96/2022 registered by the Kuvempunagar Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 and 423 of the IPC, subject to the following conditions:
1. Petitioner shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
2. Petitioner shall regularly appear before the Trial Court without fail unless exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons.
3. Petitioner shall not tamper with the prosecution witness and he shall co-operate with the police for investigation and appear before them whenever called upon till filing of charge sheet.
Petitioner shall not involve in similar offences in future.
